chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hanan ibn Sadeer, from his father, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'The most superior worship is the chastity of the belly and the private part'.

key_terms.الْفَرْجِ: The private part (referring to sexual organs/marriage)

ai.seo_question: What is considered the most superior form of worship according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) identifies chastity in the stomach and private part as the pinnacle of worship, highlighting the Shia emphasis on bodily discipline as a spiritual foundation. This hadith, found in al-Kafi's chapter on chastity, underscores that controlling physical desires is not merely ethical but constitutes the essence of devotional practice, linking physical purity directly to spiritual elevation.
